voice.name: Pop-up Atlas traveller
voice.previewText: Hup! Ooh, look at that one pop up! Hee-hee! Wheee! Hmph. Eep! Ta-da! Mmm-hmm, this little paper meadow is my favourite place to wander.
briefs: Original voice for a thumb-sized felt troll. Gender-neutral, young-sounding but not a baby. Bright, slightly breathy, soft fuzzy edges. High pitch, like a warm adult voice raised five to seven semitones with small-creature formants. Quick and bouncy, sing-song rises at phrase ends, giggles easily. No accent. Dry studio recording, no reverb.

Original voice for a tiny fuzzy craft-felt creature. Gender-neutral, childlike wonder without sounding like a baby. Very high, light and airy, a little squeaky, cheerful and curious, with playful sing-song inflection and easy giggles. No accent. Close, dry studio recording, no reverb.
